Home.title: Data Scientist & Consultant
Home.bio: With a Master's degree from the University of Tokyo, I now work at Mitsubishi Research Institute, where I focus on data science and AI consulting in the financial sector — solving complex business challenges with data and generative AI. Before that, I delivered Salesforce-based digital transformation consulting and implementation at Deloitte. Outside of work, I build quirky side projects and travel across all 47 prefectures of Japan and beyond, documenting my journey through the lens of my camera.

lines: Hi, I'm Ling — the little spirit of this site.
Wherever your cursor goes, my eyes follow.
Go ahead, poke me. Stay and play a while?
Zeli has traveled to all 47 prefectures of Japan — the stories are in the travel log.
Curious about his work? Ask me in the chat, bottom right.
Bored? Poke me for a round of Catch the Light — 45 seconds, how many can you get?

MiniGame.title: Catch the Light
MiniGame.howTo: Move Ling to catch the falling light: regular motes +10, golden ones +30. Never catch an ink blob — that's −20. Drag with your mouse or finger, or use the arrow keys. 45 seconds — how many can you get?
MiniGame.labCardDesc: Ling's 45-second mini game: catch the light, dodge the ink. Your best score lives only in your own browser.
